measured_by: internal/thought/thought_test.go (round trip, unconstrained bodies, kind-in-address, idempotent put, tamper refused)

hash.measured_by: the hash is the content address of an UNCONSTRAINED body; its own shape is s256v1:<64 hex> and is re-verified on every read (ErrTampered)

thought_kind.measured_by: thought.Put refuses unknown kinds (ErrKind); 'chunk' is deliberately NOT a kind in v1

bytes.measured_by: derived at store time; 8 MiB, empty and non-UTF-8 bodies all round-trip whole

encoding.measured_by: derived by utf8.Valid at store time, re-checked on read
